notes: Only predictions locked before kick-off by the daily run are scored. Backtests and any retrospective predictions are never mixed in.

Differences are model minus the other forecaster in log loss (negative = model better), with a 95% interval. With few matches the intervals are wide; `matches_needed` is roughly how many matches it would take to detect a gap the size the backtest found (0.08 against base rates, 0.02 against the market).
Market probabilities come from closing odds with the margin removed proportionally (an assumption). They appear a few days after each match.
